sloka: स राजभवनप्रख्यात्तस्माद्रामनिवेशनात् ।निर्गत्य ददृशे मार्गं वसिष्ठो जनसंवृतम् ॥२-५-१५॥
transliteration: sa rājabhavanaprakhyāttasmādrāmaniveśanāt ।nirgatya dadṛśe mārgaṁ vasiṣṭho janasaṁvṛtam ॥2-5-15॥

translations.english: Vasistha thereafter emerged from the abode of Rama resembling a royal palace and beheld the highways filled with people.
